scope: Field and lifecycle contracts for the workforce, lending, accounting and payments interfaces. Caller-supplied values, provider-resolved values and unsupported pairings are distinguished at each boundary.

required_fields.gateway_settings: Settings record type used when a named controller is configured
required_fields.gateway_controller: Optional settings record identity. A null reference selects singleton settings named for the gateway.

capabilities: Resolve the provider-specific payment initiation behavior.
Validate payment currency and amount according to provider settings.
Create a payment session or payment resource address for a payment request.
Report provider-specific initiation errors. Some optional checkout guards suppress URL creation, and a failed direct charge can redirect without updating the integration record.
payment_gateway.local_accounting_rule: A payment gateway account links the provider identity to a company ledger account. Its currency is taken from that ledger account. Selecting a default clears the default flag on other gateway accounts for the same company; when no other default exists the current account becomes default.
payment_gateway.availability_rule: Resolving a missing provider package or settings record may fail. In the nonphone submission guard a controller check exception suppresses URL creation. A missing URL is not evidence of a financial payment.

gateway_selection: default gateway account for company when no selection supplied
currency_inputs: rounded grand total in request currency for checkout
outstanding in party-account currency for accounting
reference conversion rate when party-account currency equals company currency and differs from request currency
exchange.phone_completion: Paid and outstanding zero; the authorization callback does not create a payment voucher.
exchange.nonphone_completion: Create and submit payment voucher with request-linked references; generate the requested sales invoice where enabled.
exchange.cancel_guard: For a Paid request check for a payment reference whose reference name matches and whose document status is below cancelled; then mark the request Cancelled if permitted.
exchange.failure_reconciliation: Compare provider capture, integration request status and local payment voucher separately before deciding whether local recovery or a provider refund is needed.

required_fields.status: Loan business status; the payroll query excludes Closed rather than enumerating a fixed set of eligible open-state names.

inputs: salary ending date used as value date
amount_service.scope: Submitted unpaid demands through salary end, positive outstanding at currency precision. The provider checks read permission and determines the allocations. Total payable can include penalties and other charges; the caller sums total, interest and principal independently.
amount_service.validation: Provider recalculates due amounts for the value date with locking during ordinary repayment validation.

required_fields.identity: stable product identity carried through payroll deduction and repayment

loan_product.scope: Payroll passes the product identity from the linked loan. Lending owns product rates, account choices, limits and allocation sequences.

provider_fields.loan_account: Principal ledger account retrieved on the linked loan
provider_fields.interest_receivable_account: Credits ordinary collected interest when loan accounting is enabled
provider_fields.payment_account: Ordinary nonpayroll payment-account fallback after explicit account, company mode of payment and bank account
provider_fields.validate_normal_repayment: When enabled, normal repayment amount cannot exceed calculated payable at currency precision. The salary caller independently caps its row.

loan_product.collection_offset_sequence: Select the product sequence for the applicable classification, then the corresponding company sequence. Allocation requires an effective sequence.

request_fields.posting_date: Caller supplies salary-slip posting date. Ordinary non-import provider validation replaces posting_date with its processing timestamp; ordinary GL rows use its date.
request_fields.repayment_type: The payroll caller passes Normal Repayment to the constructor payment_type argument; the declared provider repayment_type field defaults to Normal Repayment.
request_fields.interest_amount: Salary-row interest passed as interest_payable. Provider validation refreshes interest and allocates from amount paid under the configured collection sequence.
request_fields.principal_amount: Salary-row principal passed as payable_principal_amount. Provider validation refreshes payable principal.
request_fields.payment_account: Salary route uses the payroll payable supplied by the batch, or the company default only when there is no batch.
request_fields.value_date: Salary end date explicitly supplied. The constructor uses the current day when a caller omits a value date.

loan_repayment.create_rule: The provider constructor inserts the repayment. Payroll saves and submits it and stores the repayment ID on the originating salary row only after submission.
loan_repayment.cancel_rule: Salary cancellation targets the exact linked repayment ID. The provider reverses demand and paid balances plus applicable accounting consequences.
loan_repayment.replay_rule: A nonzero row is submitted through the constructor without a salary-row idempotency argument. A lost completion or failed link write requires reconciliation before retry.

exit_settlement.provider_compatibility: The current schedule exposes demand_generated, while the exit caller expects is_accrued. The caller passes a single dictionary to an accrual constructor that requires multiple separate values. Successful accrual through this pairing is unsupported by the inspected declarations.
exit_settlement.amount_binding: The exit loop collects loan identifiers and reuses the final original receivable amount for each; independent processing must bind amounts to each origin row.
exit_settlement.dates: The exit caller omits value_date when building repayment. Matching by settlement transaction date may miss the processing posting date.
exit_settlement.cancellation: Caller selects submitted repayment and accruals by loan and posting date, without a durable origin ID. Independent reversal requires explicit generated references.
